description: Rewrite EnclaveService.acquire to fetch over its own TLS and drop every notary field, and wire the new dependencies through EnclaveMain. The enclave now resolves a sourceId, gets auth headers, fetches response bytes R itself, and attests over a sourceId-bound binding with a PURE PASS-THROUGH transform. Covers spec tasks 4 and 5. DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 (uses SourceRegistry, SourceTlsClient, CredentialProvider).
steps: In nitro-enclave/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/EnclaveService.java change the constructor to (ObjectMapper mapper, AttestationProvider attestationProvider, SourceTlsClient sourceTlsClient, CredentialProvider credentialProvider, SourceRegistry sourceRegistry) and store the three new fields. Remove the SOURCE and ENDPOINT constants; keep CANONICALIZATION.

Rewrite acquire(request): (a) require(request, "requestId","nonce","policyVersion","evidenceId","eifDigest","sourceId"); treat requestBody as optional. REMOVE rawPayload/rawResponseB64/tlsProof from the required set. (b) DELETE the entire tlsProof validation block (proofType check + proofHash recompute) AND the 'if(!rawHash.equals(tlsProof.get("responseHash"))) throw TLS_PROOF_HASH_MISMATCH' gate.

(c) String sourceId = (String) request.get("sourceId"); SourceEntry entry = sourceRegistry.resolve(sourceId) [throws SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID for unknown]; Map<String,String> headers = credentialProvider.headersFor(entry, request); byte[] R = sourceTlsClient.fetch(entry, request.get("requestBody"), headers); String rawResponseB64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(R); String rawHash = sha256Bytes(R); Map<String,Object> rawPayload = parse R's JSON body into a Map (for pass-through only).
(d) PURE PASS-THROUGH transform (NO logic): Map<String,Object> transformed = rawPayload; String transformedHash = sha256(canonical(transformed)). Delete the old transform() that lifted 'Orders'.
(e) user_data binding LinkedHashMap order EXACTLY {requestId, nonce, policyVersion, sourceId, rawHash, transformedHash, publicKey} -- remove tlsProofHash, add sourceId after policyVersion.

(f) manifest LinkedHashMap: replace the 'source'+'endpoint' entries with a single 'sourceId' entry (in the same position), and REMOVE the 'tlsProofType'+'tlsProofHash' entries. Evidence map: REMOVE 'tlsProofResponseHash','tlsProofType','tlsProofHash'. Set evidence 'rawResponseB64' to the enclave-computed rawResponseB64. Keep every other evidence/manifest field unchanged (rawPayload, rawPayloadDigest, transformedPayload, transformedPayloadDigest, canonicalizationVersion, attestedPublicKeyBase64, manifestDigest, encryptedEvidenceReference, evidenceId, eifDigest, enclaveSignature, attestationDocument).

Rewrite nitro-enclave/src/test/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/EnclaveServiceTest.java to the new contract: construct EnclaveService with a stub SourceTlsClient that returns known bytes R (UTF-8 of a small JSON object), a stub CredentialProvider returning {}, and a real SourceRegistry; build a request with sourceId='getOrderMetrics' and the required fields. Assert: evidence has NO tlsProof* keys; evidence.rawPayloadDigest == service.sha256Bytes(R); evidence.rawResponseB64 == base64(R); transformedPayload equals the parsed R body AS-IS; captured user_data has sourceId and NO tlsProofHash and nonce=='n1'. Keep a SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID test (unknown sourceId).

In nitro-enclave/src/main/java/com/olea/dowsure/enclave/EnclaveMain.java construct SourceRegistry, a production SourceTransport (vsock->TCP binding), a SourceTlsClient over it, and PocCredentialProvider, and pass all into the new EnclaveService constructor with mapper + new JnaAttestationProvider(). Keep new VsockServer().serve(16, 5005, handler) and the exact {ok:true,evidence} / {ok:false,error} envelope untouched.
acceptance_criteria: EnclaveServiceTest asserts the produced evidence contains none of tlsProofType/tlsProofHash/tlsProofResponseHash and no 'source'/'endpoint' manifest fields; it contains 'sourceId'.
The attestation user_data (captured via a stub AttestationProvider) deserializes to keys in order requestId,nonce,policyVersion,sourceId,rawHash,transformedHash,publicKey with no tlsProofHash.
rawPayloadDigest equals sha256 of the stub-returned bytes R; rawResponseB64 equals base64(R); transformedPayload is byte-identical to the parsed R JSON body (pass-through).
An unknown sourceId causes acquire to throw IllegalArgumentException('SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID').
EnclaveMain compiles and keeps CID 16 / port 5005 and the {ok,...} envelope.
verification: cd nitro-enclave; mvn test  -> BUILD SUCCESS; rewritten EnclaveServiceTest passes together with FEAT-001's SourceRegistryTest/SourceTlsClientTest/CredentialProviderTest.
findings:
DONE. cd nitro-enclave; mvn test = BUILD SUCCESS, 19 tests (EnclaveServiceTest 3 rewritten + FEAT-001's SourceRegistryTest 6 / SourceTlsClientTest 3 / CredentialProviderTest 7), 0 failures.

EnclaveService rewritten: new constructor EnclaveService(ObjectMapper mapper, AttestationProvider attestationProvider, SourceTlsClient sourceTlsClient, CredentialProvider credentialProvider, SourceRegistry sourceRegistry). SOURCE/ENDPOINT constants removed; CANONICALIZATION kept ('RFC8785-PoC'). All tlsProof validation + TLS_PROOF_HASH_MISMATCH gate + the old transform() (Orders lift) deleted.

acquire(request): require(requestId,nonce,policyVersion,evidenceId,eifDigest,sourceId); requestBody optional. Resolves sourceId -> SourceEntry via sourceRegistry.resolve (throws SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID for unknown), gets headers via credentialProvider.headersFor(entry,request), fetches full HTTP wire bytes R via sourceTlsClient.fetch(entry, request.get('requestBody'), headers). rawResponseB64 = base64(R); rawHash = sha256Bytes(R) [over the EXACT wire bytes R]; rawPayload = parsed JSON body of R (body split on first CRLFCRLF) carried for pass-through only. transformed = rawPayload (PURE PASS-THROUGH, no logic); transformedHash = sha256(canonical(transformed)).

PARITY FACTS for FEAT-004:

user_data binding order (LinkedHashMap, canonicalized via TreeMap sort before attestation) EXACTLY 7 keys:
  requestId, nonce, policyVersion, sourceId, rawHash, transformedHash, publicKey
(sourceId inserted after policyVersion; tlsProofHash removed.)

manifest field set/order (LinkedHashMap, 9 entries):
  requestId, evidenceId, sourceId, nonce, policyVersion, rawSourceHash, transformedHash, canonicalizationVersion, attestedPublicKeyBase64
('source'+'endpoint' replaced by a single 'sourceId' in that same slot; tlsProofType+tlsProofHash removed.)

evidence map field set/order (14 entries):
  rawPayload, rawPayloadDigest, rawResponseB64, transformedPayload, transformedPayloadDigest, canonicalizationVersion, attestedPublicKeyBase64, manifestDigest, encryptedEvidenceReference, evidenceId, eifDigest, enclaveSignature, attestationDocument
(tlsProofType, tlsProofHash, tlsProofResponseHash all removed; rawResponseB64 is now the enclave-computed base64(R).)

manifestDigest = sha256(canonical(manifest)); enclaveSignature = SHA256withECDSA over canonical(manifest); attestationDocument = base64url(no-pad) of attestationProvider.generateAttestation(canonical(binding) UTF-8 bytes, publicKey DER). canonical() = TreeMap key-sort + Jackson compact (unchanged).

Error codes (IllegalArgumentException message): SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID (unknown id), SOURCE_RESPONSE_INVALID (unparseable body), plus TLS_HANDSHAKE_FAILED/SOURCE_AUTH_FAILED surfaced from FEAT-001 classes.

EnclaveMain wired: constructs new SourceRegistry(), SourceTransport.TcpSourceTransport() (the vsock->TCP production seam), SourceTlsClient(transport, CA_BUNDLE) where CA_BUNDLE=env SOURCE_CA_BUNDLE or classpath 'source-ca-bundle.pem', PocCredentialProvider(), and passes all into the new EnclaveService ctor with new JnaAttestationProvider(). VsockServer().serve(16, 5005, handler) and the {ok:true,evidence}/{ok:false,error} envelope unchanged.

EnclaveServiceTest rewritten: drives a real SourceTlsClient over an in-process SSLServerSocket stub (reuses FEAT-001 test resources test-server.p12 / test-ca.pem) with AMAZON_SP_BASE_URL pointed at the stub so resolve('getOrderMetrics') -> stub host:port. Asserts rawPayloadDigest==sha256(R), rawResponseB64==base64(R), transformedPayload==rawPayload==parsed body (pass-through), no tlsProof*/source/endpoint keys, user_data has sourceId + nonce 'n1' and no tlsProofHash, and unknown sourceId -> SOURCE_SCOPE_INVALID.
